subject: A change for the group catch-up
text: Can you believe how quickly this quarter is slipping by? I was staring at the sprint board and thinking our usual Friday catch-up might be doing us more harm than good. People are mentally checked out, and the same few voices end up steering everything. What if we swap it for a quick lunch-and-learn next Wednesday instead? We would order something simple, keep the laptops closed, and let each person share one small thing that helped them this week or one thing that made them laugh. It feels lighter, easier, and maybe a little more human. If that still feels like too much structure, we could make it optional and keep it to twenty minutes. I would rather try something small than keep pretending the old format is working. I just keep feeling we need a way to connect that does not turn into status reporting. The project has been intense lately, and I would like one hour where we talk like people, not ticket numbers. Maybe we can rotate who picks the conversation starter, so it does not always fall to me. Tell me what you think before Thursday so I can book the room and the food or maybe choose a different plan.
